name: Vinasse, from the production of glutamic acid
description: Humid byproduct of the production of glutamic acid obtained after fermentation of organic substances, particularly molasses. This product has been concentrated and demineralised.

name: Linseed meal, oil > 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of linseeds (Linum usitatissimumL.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only. Other names: linseed cake, linseed oil cake, linseed oilcake, flaxseed meal, flaxseed oil meal, flaxseed oilmeal.

name: Zinc methionine
description: Methionine and zinc complex used as a source of organic zinc. These products have a variable zinc content.

name: Fish meal, protein 62%
description: Fish product or fishery byproduct obtained by processing whole or parts of fish. This type of fish meal contains 58-63% protein (as fed). Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Maize germ meal, oil 5-20%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture, obtained by extraction of maize germs (Zea maysL.), consisting of spent germs to which parts of the endosperm and outer skins may still adhere. This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only. Other name: corn germ meal (USA).

name: Maize, extruded
description: Extruded maize grain (Zea maysL.). Other name: extruded corn (USA).

name: Ferric chloride
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula FeCl3. Other names: iron(III) chloride, ferric chloride.

name: Soybean meal, oil < 5%, 48% protein + oil, extruded
description: Extuded byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.), with partial reintroduction of the hulls. This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. It should contain about 46% (as fed) of protein + oil.

name: Alfalfa, dehydrated, protein > 25% dry matter
description: Dehydrated aerial part of alfalfa (Medicago sativaL.) containing more than 25% protein (in dry matter).

name: Manganese oxide MnO2
description: Inorganic compound with the formula MnO2. Other names: manganese(IV) oxide, manganese dioxide.

name: Manganese oxide MnO
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula MnO. Other name: manganese(II) oxide.

name: Manganese oxide MnO-Mn2O3
description: Inorganic chemical compound consistinf of a mixture of manganese(II) oxide MnO and manganese(IV) oxide Mn2O3.

name: Manganese sulfate monohydrate
description: Manganese(II) sulfate monohydrate, or manganese sulfate monohydrate, is the hydrated inorganic chemical compound (salt) with the formula MnSO4·H2O. Alternative spellings: Manganese(II) sulphate monohydrate, manganese sulphate monohydrate (UK).

name: Ferrous sulfate monohydrate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula FeSO4·H2O. Alternative spellings: Iron(II) sulphate monohydrate, ferrous sulphate monohydrate (UK). Other names: iron(II) sulfate monohydrate, ferrous sulfate monohydrate.

name: Palm oil
description: Oil extracted from the pulp (mesocarp) of palm fruits (Elaeis guineensisJacq. orElaeis melanococcaauct.). Palm oil is a different product from palm kernel oil, which is extracted from the fruit kernels.

name: Chickpea, kabuli type
description: Seeds of chickpea (Cicer arietinumL.) from kabuli varieties. Kabuli (also called garbanzo) chickpeas are tan-coated and are grown primarily in the Mediterranean area and in South America. They contain less crude fibre than the smaller and dark-coated desi types grown in the Indian subcontinent.

name: Monosodium phosphate hydrate
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound with the formula NaH2PO4·nH2O.

name: Maize flour byproduct, protein 8-18%, oil <5%
description: Byproduct of flour or grits manufacture from maize grain (Zea maysL.), consisting of grain fragments and some maize germs.

name: Grape seeds
description: Dried byproduct of wine or grape juice manufacture obtained from the pressure of grapes (Vitis viniferaL.). Grape seeds result from the removal of the seeds in certain processes.

name: Manganese carbonate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula MnCO3.
